{{Quote|I still remember seeing the starship. It roared like a Gorax in the sky, trailing smoke and flame.|[[Treek/Legends|Treek]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Gorax''' were a species of behemoths found on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], who frequently preyed on the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].

==Biology and culture==
[[File:Gorax-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A gorax with pet [[Boar-wolf/Legends|boar-wolves]] and an Ewok running underneath]]
[[Lyrre T'enna]] seemed to believe that the Gorax were native to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], conjecturing that the gravitational pull of the planet [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] on its moon allowed for native species to grow to incredible sizes.<ref name=":1">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> Other scientists believed the Gorax originated on the homeworld of the [[Phlog/Legends|Phlogs]], another gigantic species found on the moon, and that both the Gorax and Phlogs were introduced to the moon by the crashed slave caravel ''[[Sickly Tremor]]''.<ref name="Castaways of Endor">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/feature20081201.html|text=Castaways of Endor|int=Castaways of Endor}}</ref>

[[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] in appearance, adult Gorax were usually over six meters tall. Some specimens were up to thirty meters in height. Their bodies were covered in thick, matted fur, which was black, brown, or sometimes gray. Their hairless faces were dominated by protruding lower jaws and heavy brows. Some Gorax had hoof-like feet, while others had long toes, and either a long, narrow heel, or a backward-pointing fourth toe. Though they were omnivorous, their pointed teeth were well adapted to eating meat. They had wide, long, and pointed ears that were highly sensitive to noises made by small animals. Though their hearing was strong, their eyesight was weak. Bright light pained them, making them nocturnal hunters.

[[File:Gorax_-_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|A Gorax attacks a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]]]

Powerful but primitive, and albeit demonstrating signs of developing [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]], their technology was crude even in comparison to the Ewoks. They were limited to simple items such as clubs, stone axes, animal-skin clothing, and the like.<ref name=":0" /> They communicated by making grumbling noises. Gorax were solitary creatures, but they did domesticate [[Boar-wolf/Legends|boar-wolves]]<ref name=":1" /> (usually by killing a mother boar-wolf and stealing a newborn pup).<ref name="DB-boar-wolf">{{DB|creature|boarwolf|boar-wolf}}</ref> They also raided [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] villages, where they smashed through walls to capture Ewoks. Gorax took Ewoks both for food and to be kept in a hanging cage in a Gorax lair as pets. Luckily for the Ewoks, Gorax were not a common species, with fewer than two dozen estimated to reside on Endor.<ref name="UA">''[[Ultimate Adversaries]]''</ref>

==Gorax in the galaxy==
According to an Ewok legend, the [[Gorax King]] was imprisoned in the night sky above [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] by the [[Golden One/Legends|golden sun god]]. The Ewoks referred to the [[Din Nebula/Legends|Din Nebula]] as the "Gorax King's Heart," in reference to the legend.<ref name="Endor and the Moddell Sector">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref>

A [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] attack was known as [[gorax smash]].<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

[[Unidentified Gorax|One Gorax]] dwelled on high crags beyond the [[Desert of Salma/Legends|Desert of Salma]], which was far from the Endor forests. His home was a [[rearing spider]]-infested cavern built beneath a [[Forbidden Fortress of the Gorax|mountain fortress]].<ref name=":0">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref> It was not known if the giant built his massive fortress.<ref name="DB-Gorax">{{DB|species|gorax|Gorax}}</ref> This Gorax kidnapped two [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who had crash-landed on Endor, [[Catarine Towani|Catarine]] and [[Jeremitt Towani]]. Their children, [[Mace Towani|Mace]] and [[Cindel Towani|Cindel]], rescued them with the help of a group of Ewoks from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] (including [[Deej Warrick]] and his sons [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]], [[Widdle Warrick/Legends|Willy]], and [[Weechee Warrick]]). During the rescue mission, the Towani children and the Ewok warriors killed the giant by making him fall into one of the many chasms in his fortress.<ref name=":0" />

A Gorax head was found in the trophy room of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ozzik Sturn]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MCQ-gorax.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Gorax concept art by [[Ralph McQuarrie]]]]
The Gorax species made its first appearance in the [[1984]] TV movie ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''.<ref name=":0" /> The individual Gorax was played by [[Jon Berg]],<ref name="Industrial Light & Magic: The Art of Special Effects">''[[Industrial Light & Magic: The Art of Special Effects]]''</ref> who also designed it. He portrayed it with both a stop-motion model as well as himself in costume.<ref name="Smith">{{WebCite|url=https://www.yahoo.com/tv/star-wars-ewoks-caravan-of-courage-the-battle-190346641.html|text='Star Wars': How the Ewoks Came to TV 31 Years Ago|author=Alter, Ethan|date=2015-12-15|work=[[Wikipedia:Yahoo!|Yahoo!]]|archivedate=20200805194445}}</ref>

Gorax shares basic similarities with the [[Bobog]],<ref name="Hard Sell">{{Ewoks|Hard Sell}}</ref> the [[Grudakk]],<ref name="The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense">''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]''</ref> and the [[Red Nebula temple guardian]]'s [[Red Nebula temple guardian's species|species]],<ref name="Star Wars 1977 50">[[Star Wars (1977) 50|''Star Wars'' (1977) 50]]</ref> notably a prolific stature, but no source has indicated whether any of them share genetic ancestry.
